t: Lvliang Dawu Airport
s: November 7, 2025 - Lvliang Dawu Airport or Lüliang Dawu Airport (IATA: LLV, ICAO: ZBLL) is an airport serving the city of Lüliang in Shanxi Province, China. It is located near the town of Dawu in Fangshan County, 20.5 kilometers from the city center. Construction of the airport began on 21 February 2009 with an investment of 764 million yuan, and was originally projected to be finished in 2011.

Lvliang City
s: Lvliang City (Lyuliang City) is a prefecture-level city under the jurisdiction of Shanxi Province , China. It is located in the western part of central Shanxi Province, spanning from 36°43' N to 38°43' N and 110°22' E to 112°19' E. It borders Taiyuan City and Jinzhong City to the east, faces Shaanxi Province across the Yellow River to the west, and adjoins Linfen City to the south and Xinzhou to the north.
